stops.note: the name of a hill in Jiangxi province where fine white clay was mined for porcelain
stops.meaning: 'high ridge', a place name and source of porcelain clay

stops.note: transliterated by a Jesuit missionary reporting on Chinese porcelain manufacture
stops.meaning: fine white clay used to make porcelain

stops.note: named after Gaoling hill near Jingdezhen, China's porcelain capital; described by the Jesuit Père d'Entrecolles in 1712
stops.meaning: a fine white clay used in porcelain and other products

current_meaning: a fine, white clay mineral used in porcelain, paper, and cosmetics
